before.front: Which covalent linkage creates the DNA/RNA sugar–phosphate backbone?
before.prompt: Which covalent linkage creates the DNA/RNA sugar–phosphate backbone?

before.front: Does a phosphodiester bond connect the paired bases across two DNA strands?
before.back: No; it connects successive nucleotides within one strand.
before.prompt: Does a phosphodiester bond connect the paired bases across two DNA strands?

after.front: Which covalent linkage joins the 3′-OH of one nucleotide to the 5′-phosphate of the next?
after.back: A phosphodiester bond: a covalent 3′–O–P–O–5′ connection in the DNA/RNA backbone.
after.prompt: Which covalent linkage joins the 3′-OH of one nucleotide to the 5′-phosphate of the next?
after.sourceLabel: DNA & RNA matching notes · supplied October 5

after.front: Which bonds link complementary bases across paired DNA strands?
after.back: Noncovalent hydrogen bonds link complementary base pairs; covalent phosphodiester bonds run along each backbone.
after.prompt: Which bonds link complementary bases across paired DNA strands?
after.sourceLabel: DNA & RNA matching notes · supplied October 5
after.studyNote: Dashed rungs represent base-pair hydrogen bonds; the rails represent covalent sugar–phosphate backbones.

after.front: A cell makes RNA using a DNA template. Which process is this?
after.prompt: A cell makes RNA using a DNA template. Which process is this?
after.back: Transcription — RNA synthesis from a DNA template.
after.sourceLabel: DNA & RNA matching notes · supplied October 5
after.studyNote: Gene-expression regulation controls when and how much RNA is transcribed; it does not replace the DNA template.

after.front: Each parental DNA strand templates a new complementary DNA strand. Which process is this?
after.prompt: Each parental DNA strand templates a new complementary DNA strand. Which process is this?
after.back: Replication — DNA synthesis; each daughter DNA molecule contains one parental strand and one newly made strand.
after.sourceLabel: DNA & RNA matching notes · supplied October 5

after.front: A ribosome reads mRNA codons to assemble an amino-acid sequence. Which process is this?
after.prompt: A ribosome reads mRNA codons to assemble an amino-acid sequence. Which process is this?
after.back: Translation — protein synthesis using the nucleotide sequence of mRNA.
after.sourceLabel: DNA & RNA matching notes · supplied October 5

after.front: A gene is deleted or one DNA nucleotide is changed. What general term covers both changes?
after.prompt: A gene is deleted or one DNA nucleotide is changed. What general term covers both changes?
after.back: Mutation — a change in the DNA sequence.
after.sourceLabel: DNA & RNA matching notes · supplied October 5
after.studyNote: A SNP is variation at a single nucleotide position. A deletion and a mutation in general are not automatically SNPs.
